prespecified_analysis.audit: original ensemble, clean batch_1, official IoU .5; all six matches; same-team overlap degree >1 flags split/merge; dominant opponent overlap flags wrong-team; unmatched same-team overlap flags timing; otherwise phantom; exclusive precedence wrong-team, split, merge, timing, phantom; flags retained; WOH timeline uses largest increase in spurious events in fixed 60-second bins
prespecified_analysis.candidate: spell_balanced; fixed before any new results; never replace with ablation winner
prespecified_analysis.confirmation: same comparison_gate against raw-parent EMA baseline and control: gain > .002, missing gain > 0, wins >= 4/6, both batches positive, each scenario >= -.01
prespecified_analysis.factorial: sampling_only-control, loss_only-control, combined-control, interaction=combined-sampling_only-loss_only+control; exploratory; no retuning
prespecified_analysis.full_recipe_seed_confirmation: fresh fine and coarse models, same masks and decoder
prespecified_analysis.guard: WMX candidate versus paired ensemble control and parent baseline: objective >= reference-.01 and every scenario >= reference-.01; also report both batches and individual fine seeds; no single-match CI
prespecified_analysis.sampling_pairing: loss_only matches control windows; sampling_only matches combined windows
prespecified_analysis.seed_mapping: existing _seed_for_fold(base_seed, WMX, fold_index), including guard fold 0
